title: MERIT MEDICAL SYSTEMS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Merit Medical Systems, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026, providing historical revenue information disaggregated by new foundational and therapeutic product categories for fiscal years 2022-2025 and quarterly data for 2024-2025. The filing is Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure and does not constitute a revision or restatement of previously reported consolidated financial statements.
key_points: Merit Medical reported total revenue of $1.52 billion for FY2025, up from $1.36 billion in FY2024
Foundational revenue was $1.03 billion in 2025 versus $964 million in 2024
Therapeutic revenue was $487 million in 2025 versus $392 million in 2024
The new product category breakdown (Foundational vs Therapeutic) is being provided for period-over-period comparisons
This supplemental revenue detail will not be provided on a recurring basis in future periods
The filing includes quarterly breakdowns for Q1-Q4 2025 compared to corresponding 2024 periods
why_it_matters: This is a company-specific financial disclosure from a medical device manufacturer. It provides no information relevant to market structure or macro catalysts. The filing is designed to help analysts understand Merit Medical's revenue mix under its new product categorization but has no bearing on monetary policy, interest rates, Treasury operations, or broader market dynamics.
